item.summary: refactor(anthropic): split session catalog into concept modules (#124342) * refactor(anthropic): split session-catalog into concept modules Follow the #124178 sibling seam pattern while preserving behavior. Remove the max-lines suppression and baseline entry after the split. * refactor(anthropic): own record caches in session-catalog-discovery The record-shaped caches (catalogDiscoveryCache, claudeSessionScanCache, their entry types, bounds, and TTLs) are consumed only by discovery; moving them out of scan removes the scan->discovery type-import edge flagged by the madge topology gate and leaves scan as record-agnostic fs primitives.
